header.title: Installed Decks

tour.step1_content: Organize all flashcard decks installed from the Marketplace or created by you to begin studying.
tour.step2_content: Click here to discover hundreds of high-quality vocabulary, grammar, and Kanji decks shared by the community.
tour.step3_content: Quickly search by deck name, filter by topic category, JLPT level, or active study status.
tour.step4_content_installed: Displays deck title, author name, current study status (In Use / Installed), and brief summary.
tour.step4_content_empty: After installing decks from Marketplace, they will appear here for you to study and track progress.
tour.step5_content: Click this button to start a review session powered by smart spaced repetition (Anki SM-2 / FSRS) for deep memory retention.
